text: Here's how to win every snowball fight this winter.
Grab a plastic storage bin,
pack it full of snow,
and flip it over to make perfect snow bricks.
Stack them in a big circle,
leaving a small window in the front.
Now cut a pool noodle in half
and tape it to the inside wall
as a snowball ramp.
Load it up,
so fresh ammo rolls right into your hands.
Then tie two bungee cords across the window
to make a giant slingshot.
And for the final touch,
poke a periscope out the top,
so you can spy on the enemy without being seen.
Now when your brother sneaks up,
you'll see him coming first.
Grab a snowball,
pull back,
and fire.
He never stood a chance.
